commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' A quickly taken corner by Real Madrid.
90+1' The resulting set piece from Mallorca is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
89' Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.

88' Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Alejandro Ruiz blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Real Madrid win a free kick.
86' The attendance for today's match is 72394.
86' Carlo Ancelotti decides to make a substitution. Rodrygo will be replaced by Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid).
86' We are about to witness a substitution. Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) is replacing Luka Modric.
85' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
84' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) takes the free kick from distance, but the defensive wall charges down the ball. The referee points to the corner flag and Real Madrid will take a corner.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Antonio Sanchez leaves the pitch and Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca) comes on.
83' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alejandro Ruiz saw the whole situation. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Real Madrid.
83' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

78' 1 - 0 Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Luka Modric. His header was precise and ended up in the top right corner, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 1:0.
78' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) will deliver the corner kick.
78' A cross into the box from Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) is cleared. The ball is out of play. Real Madrid win a corner kick.
73' Substitution. Daniel Rodriguez walks off the pitch and Sergi Darder (Mallorca) comes on as a substitute.
73' Here is a change. Cyle Larin is going off and Javier Aguirre gives the last tactical orders to Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
73' Substitution. Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) in, Manu Morlanes out.
73' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Andriy Lunin, who smothers the ball.
72' Joselu (Real Madrid) blows an opportunity from close range as he heads a rebound onto the right post!
70' What was Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

69' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Rodrygo (Real Madrid) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Predrag Rajkovic pulls off a brilliant save.
69' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joselu (Real Madrid) replaces Toni Kroos.
64' Some patient build-up play from Real Madrid as they look to unlock the defence.
61' Matija Nastasic (Mallorca) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
60' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) replacing Vinicius Junior.
57' A cross into the box picks out Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
54' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) unleashes a tremendous shot from distance, but it crashes against the right post! If it had flown more to the left it would have been a cracker!
54' Mallorca are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
53' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) takes the free kick with a stunning missile of a shot, but it goes just wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
52' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) touches the ball with his hand. Real Madrid are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
51' A player from Real Madrid commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
51' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
49' The ball is cleared after Luka Modric (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
46' The game is over for Siebe Van Der Heyden (Mallorca). Toni Lato comes on for the second half.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Alejandro Ruiz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Andriy Lunin (Real Madrid) attempts to discuss the decision with Alejandro Ruiz, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
45+3' A rebound falls to Cyle Larin (Mallorca) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
45+2' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) takes it short.
45+1' The resulting corner from Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is cleared by the defence.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the bar!

42' CHANCE! Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he sends his shot well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
35' Alejandro Ruiz has issued a yellow card to Rodrygo (Real Madrid).
34' A cross from Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
30' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) has a great chance to score, but he blasts the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.

25' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) receives a pin-point pass in the middle of the pitch which gives him a great opportunity to score. He is unfazed by the distance and slams the ball towards the goal. He is unlucky as he hits one of his own teammates.
22' Alejandro Ruiz blows the whistle, Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is penalised for a foul.
21' Real Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

20' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) does well inside the box to bring down a pass from Luka Modric. He gets away a decent shot but it creeps just past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.

17' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Federico Valverde (Real Madrid). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.

13' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the top right corner. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Predrag Rajkovic makes a comfortable save.
13' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
12' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play. Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
10' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
5' Real Madrid keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Siebe Van Der Heyden (Mallorca) was quite harsh and Alejandro Ruiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Mallorca will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Alejandro Ruiz.
